cases.titulo: When an E2E test breaks, who is to blame?
cases.problema: QA teams spend hours deciding whether a failing test is flaky, the environment is down, there is a real bug, or the test is outdated. I saw this firsthand while monitoring critical user journeys at Voidr.
cases.abordagem: I built an agent that gathers evidence from Playwright traces, classifies the cause with a model trained on labeled cases, and uses a local LLM to write the report and suggest a new selector. GitHub Actions deliberately injects failures every 3 hours, so the correct diagnosis is always known.
cases.resultado: 98.4% accuracy across 192 failures, compared with 77.1% for manual rules; 20 out of 20 on previously unseen cases. The first model caught 0% of real bugs; three clues a person would use fixed that.

cases.problema: At Shippify, I worked on routing for clients such as Amazon, Mercado Livre and Natura. I wanted to understand the problem beyond the company's code, using open data.
cases.abordagem: A pipeline using SPTrans GTFS and live GPS data (22,274 stops, 1,349 routes), a hexagonal map of transit access, and a capacity-constrained route planner that runs in the browser.
cases.resultado: 11–29% fewer kilometers than nearest-neighbor dispatch, using the same fleet. I also showed that the official timetable does not predict where buses slow down (R² of −0.10), which is why the speed model uses GPS data.

cases.problema: Genomic data is hard to explore for people who do not code. I experienced this during my undergraduate technology research at INTERAGRO, working with over 200,000 bovine genomic records.
cases.abordagem: A Python pipeline that retrieves genes from Ensembl, finds Cas9 cut sites, and checks for off-target matches against an index of 5.9 million sites in the human exome, presented through four browser games.
cases.resultado: 25 genes, 8,107 cut sites, and a test requiring identical scores from the Python and TypeScript implementations for every published guide RNA.

cases.problema: Any system that moves balances between accounts has to survive two requests spending the same money at once, and has to prove afterwards that nothing was created or lost. I wanted to solve that in Java, with the stack a banking back end would use.
cases.abordagem: A Spring Boot API (Java 21, Spring Security with JWT, JPA/Hibernate, Flyway, PostgreSQL) where every transaction is an append-only set of legs that nets to zero per asset. Ledger writes lock the team row, and a reconcile endpoint replays the whole ledger against the cached balances.
cases.resultado: A JUnit test races eight payouts against a treasury that can only cover three, and the writes are serialized so no account but the outside world goes negative. Tested with JUnit and Testcontainers in CI, and the browser build passes the same contract scenario as the API.

cases.titulo: Which of my sites does this CVE reach?
cases.problema: NVD and the GitHub Advisory Database often describe the same flaw with different ids, scores and version ranges. Without merging them, a security team gets duplicate alerts and still can't say which of its own machines are affected.
cases.abordagem: An ASP.NET Core 10 API with Entity Framework Core and PostgreSQL that ingests both sources, merges records sharing any identifier, adds CISA KEV and EPSS exploitation signals, matches version ranges against each site's software inventory and alerts through webhooks.
cases.resultado: 1,409 fetched advisories became 1,054 vulnerabilities, 342 of them reported by both sources. Merging is order-independent and idempotent, both covered by xUnit tests, and rules learned from real data stopped ancient OpenSSH CVEs from flagging OpenSSH 10.

cases.problema: Dados genômicos são difíceis de explorar para quem não programa, algo que vivi na iniciação tecnológica no INTERAGRO, com 200 mil+ registros genômicos de bovinos.

cases.problema: Todo sistema que movimenta saldos entre contas precisa aguentar duas requisições gastando o mesmo dinheiro ao mesmo tempo, e provar depois que nada foi criado nem perdido. Quis resolver isso em Java, com a pilha que um back-end bancário usaria.

cases.titulo: Quais dos meus sites essa CVE atinge?
